dialogues.speaker: Zayah
dialogues.text: Bayda Harbor is too close to Fontaine, so Fontainian goods aren't quite in vogue anymore.

dialogues.speaker: Zayah
dialogues.text: But Liyue? Now that's a different story.

dialogues.speaker: Zayah
dialogues.text: My mercantile nose is never wrong, I tell you! We just need to ship in some fine Liyue cuisine, such as...
